Interface Task<T extends @Nullable Object>

Type Parameters:
T - the type of the result
public interface Task<T extends @Nullable Object>
Work that runs on a virtual thread, with its completion hooks.

The hooks, the progress and the messages are delivered through the UiExecutor: on the EDT with the UI module. Cancelling interrupts the thread; a task that ends by InterruptedException or CancellationException after cancellation runs its onCancel(Runnable) hooks. A failure with no onFailure(Consumer) hook goes to the FailureHandler. A task belongs to the scope it was started in: closing the scope cancels it.

Run a task with TaskService.run(Task, Scope), or return it from a command handler, which runs it. A handler that has nothing to run, such as one whose confirmation was declined, returns none().

    • none

      static <T extends @Nullable Object> Task<T> none()
      Returns the task with no work, which a command handler returns when it has nothing to run. Running it does nothing: no thread starts, no input is blocked, and its hooks never run. It may be run any number of times.
      Type Parameters:
      T - the type of the result
      Returns:
      the task with no work
